reviews.text: Great company to service your pool! I was given Sterling from my home warranty company due to a filter problem. From that time on, they treated me like I was their only customer (I assure you, they have a lot!). Kevin and the group do a fantastic job and you would be hard pressed to find a better company!
reviews.author: Eric Hoyle

reviews.text: I have been a customer of Sterling pool for over 30 years (I know them very well). I have been extremely satisfied with their monthly services and repair work. I have engaged them for repairs to my pumps, lights, timers and pool deck repairs. I am more than satisfied with the work performed and the prices were competitive and reasonable. The crew is very easy to work with, they respond very quickly when there is a problem.
reviews.author: Frank Hatchett

reviews.text: I have used Sterling for several years.  Kevin and his crew do an outstanding job of keeping my pool looking and running great.  It never fails, 3 or 4 times a year I have an equipment issue, normally nothing major but none the less, needs repair.  Kevin is quick to respond, gets the job done, and doesn't nickel and dime me.  Thanks for all your help!
reviews.author: John Woodruff

reviews.text: Kevin and his team are very professional, cost effective, and are able to tackle my nasty pool. They were able to get it sparkling, fix the leak, and get my pool running again even with the creative ways given the computer is fried. I highly recommend them and will be using them for weekly service to keep my pool sparkling.
reviews.author: An Anchor in Storms

reviews.text: Sterling Pool Service is ALWAYS timely and our Service Technician is Professional and Courteous. I would also like to recognize the corporate office where customer is always at a premium and it is not uncommon that the owners reach out to me to make sure our equipment and service is satisfactory
reviews.author: Chris D

reviews.text: Great group of people they did a excellent job of maintaining my pool.  They also did a great job when we had to replace our equipment for a competitive rate. They communicated any recommendations clearly and did the requested work in a timely manor.
reviews.author: scott tiveron

reviews.text: I have used Sterling Pool for over 20 years. They have also responded right away and have been able to fix every problem. One time someone ran through my fence and into my pool equipment during the winter. All of the equipment and pipes were busted. It was going to freeze within three days over a weekend. Sterling worked long hours and Saturday to make sure the pool equipment was working and the pipes would not freeze. Sterling will always be my pool repair man.
reviews.author: Wally Orear

reviews.text: Wow, what a great pool service!  They are honest, dependable, communicate well and take great care of their customers.  I've used several other pool services companies within DFW in the past and they are by far the BEST pool service I've had.  Most of the other services I've used were not dependable or didn't do a good job on cleaning.....can't say enough good things about this company.
reviews.author: Jason Sukenik

data.summary: Reviews appear highly authentic, reflecting a long-established, reputable pool service company. The detailed, specific praise from long-term customers is credible. The primary concern is a lack of recent reviews, but the historical pattern is strongly positive with no discernible fake signals in the content.
fake_signals: All 8 sampled Google reviews are 5-star from 5-7 years ago, creating a potential recency gap
Limited recent review volume on primary platforms

positive_evidence: Reference to service initiated via a home warranty company
Implied standing behind work through long-term relationships and emergency response

authentic_signals: Reviews contain specific, credible details (e.g., 'Kevin and the group', 'over 30 years', 'filter problem from home warranty', 'crew worked Saturday to prevent freeze')
Varied writing styles and specific scenarios mentioned
Mentions of both routine service and emergency repairs
data.discrepancy_explanation: Ratings are highly consistent across Google (4.7) and Yelp (4.5). BBB A+ rating with no complaints aligns with positive customer feedback.
